title: Modern 3BR Apartment in New Cairo
description: A spacious modern apartment in the heart of New Cairo. Features an open-plan living area, premium kitchen finishes, and a private balcony overlooking the city. Walking distance to schools, malls, and parks.

title: Luxury Penthouse — Zamalek
address: 26 Hassan Sabry St, Zamalek, Cairo, Egypt
description: Stunning penthouse on the 18th floor with panoramic Nile views. Rooftop terrace, double-height ceilings, and private elevator access. Rarely available in this building.

title: Cozy Studio — Maadi Corniche
description: Well-maintained studio apartment on the ground floor. Tiled throughout, fitted kitchen, and a small private garden. Ideal for young professionals.

title: Family Villa — Sheikh Zayed
address: Compound Beverly Hills, Sheikh Zayed, Giza, Egypt
description: Expansive compound villa with private garden and pool. Gated community with 24/7 security, tennis courts, and a community club. Price upon request — contact agent for valuation.

title: Investment Apartment — 6th of October
address: Sector 3, 6th of October City, Giza, Egypt
description: Solid investment property in a rapidly developing area. Currently tenanted at EGP 6,500/month. Strong rental yield and capital appreciation expected over the next 3–5 years.

title: Duplex with Nile View — Agouza
address: Corniche El Nil, Agouza, Giza, Egypt
description: Two-level duplex with direct Nile views from the upper floor. Spacious living area, renovated kitchen, and two private balconies. Premium location on the Corniche.

title: Affordable 1BR — Heliopolis
description: Neat and tidy one-bedroom close to the airport and city centre. Recently repainted, new AC units. Immediate occupancy available.

title: Ground Floor with Garden — Katameya
description: Ground-floor apartment with a generous private garden in one of Cairo's most sought-after gated communities. Freshly renovated with high-end finishes throughout.
